question.en: Did the doctors find out how the woman died?
question.zh: 医生查明了这位妇女的死因吗？

sentences.en: Did the doctors find out how the woman died?
sentences.zh: 医生查明了这位妇女的死因吗？

sentences.en: The mummy of an Egyptian woman who died in 800 B.C. has just had an operation.
sentences.zh: 死于公元前800年的一位埃及妇女的木乃伊刚刚接受了一次手术。

sentences.en: The mummy is that of Shepenmut who was once a singer in the Temple of Thebes.
sentences.zh: 这具木乃伊是谢潘穆特的，她曾在底比斯神庙里当过歌手。

sentences.en: As there were strange marks on the X-ray plates taken of the mummy,
sentences.zh: 由于给木乃伊拍的X光片上有奇怪的斑点，

sentences.en: doctors have been trying to find out whether the woman died of a rare disease.
sentences.zh: 医生们一直在设法查明这位妇女是否死于一种罕见的疾病。

sentences.en: The only way to do this was to operate.
sentences.zh: 唯一的办法就是动手术。

sentences.en: The operation, which lasted for over four hours,
sentences.zh: 手术持续了四个多小时，

sentences.en: proved to be very difficult because of the hard resin which covered the skin.
sentences.zh: 由于皮肤上覆盖着一层硬树脂，手术非常困难。

sentences.en: The doctors removed a section of the mummy and sent it to a laboratory.
sentences.zh: 医生们从木乃伊身上取下一段，送到实验室。

sentences.en: They also found something which the X-ray plates did not show: a small wax figure of the god Duamutef.
sentences.zh: 他们还发现了X光片上没有显示的东西：一个杜阿穆特夫神的小蜡像。

sentences.en: This god which has the head of a cow was normally placed inside a mummy.
sentences.zh: 这个长着牛头的神通常是放在木乃伊里面的。

sentences.en: The doctors have not yet decided how the woman died.
sentences.zh: 医生们还没有确定这位妇女的死因。

sentences.en: They feared that the mummy would fall to pieces when they cut it open,
sentences.zh: 他们担心切开木乃伊时会碎成粉末，

sentences.en: but fortunately this has not happened.
sentences.zh: 但幸运的是这种情况没有发生。

sentences.en: The mummy successfully survived the operation.
sentences.zh: 这具木乃伊成功地经受住了这次手术。
